SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM BC.KII_PO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PODOWN' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'BING' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(B.STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, A.KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, A.KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(B.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(B.CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(B.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(B.ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, NVL(B.ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(B.RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(B.PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, NVL(B.LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, NVL(B.REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(B.REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, NVL(B.PRE_GR_FLAG,' ') AS PRE_GR_FLAG, NVL(B.REMARK1,' ') AS REMARK, NVL(B.REMARK2,' ') AS REMARK2, NVL(B.REF_IF_NO,' ') AS REF_IF_NO, NVL(B.ITEM_NAME, ' ') AS DESCRIPTION FROM BC.KII_PO_KEPTRXL A, APPS.KII_PO_KEP_PODETAIL_V B WHERE A.KEY_1 = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.KEY_2 = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND A.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND TRIM(A.KEY_9) IS NULL ORDER BY A.KEY_1,A.KEY_2
UPDATE BC.KII_PO_KEPTRXL A SET KEY_9 = CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APPS.KII_PO_KEP_PODETAIL_V B WHERE A.KEY_1 = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.KEY_2 = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'E' END , KEY_8 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL
